applicability_to_track_a.study: US Survey of Consumer Expectations (SCE) one-year inflation expectations
applicability_to_track_a.submission_scope: The A82 historical reconstruction and its disclosed offline result reproduction. Describe any B-line result separately; do not call retrospective or previously observed months a strictly prospective blind forecast.
applicability_to_track_a.one_command_script_scope: The one-command script must execute the explicitly declared result-reproduction scope; the reproducibility statement must identify which results it reproduces and any required permitted inputs/cache. Real API generation is a separately disclosed mode and must not be triggered implicitly by a dry-run or cached-recomputation command.
applicability_to_track_a.current_gap: The current study.yaml and study README describe a two-month, 20-synthetic-person smoke demo with seed 42; they are not the A82 configuration or its complete run ledger. No submission one-command script has yet been accepted as A82 reproduction.

competition_requirement.readme: Provide instructions that state how the submitted study and claimed results are reproduced.

platform_study_convention.interpretation: These are SocioVerse2 platform conventions and examples; do not claim that every runtime artifact must be redistributed. Keep generated personal trajectories out of the ZIP unless separately cleared.

items.focus: Months and information cutoffs; calibration versus evaluation; truth acquisition time; model-knowledge boundaries and forecast sealing.

Actual scale, seed definitions, model, calls, cost, runtime, failures/repairs, and independent reproduction.
Source-by-source research/model-processing/redistribution terms, de-identification, release scope, and historical news/gasoline vintages.
